title: Implement Display, FromStr and Ord for Version
task: Give Version in src/lib.rs a text form and an ordering, keeping its fields, new and bump_patch unchanged. Implement std::fmt::Display as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH in decimal (Version::new(1, 20, 3) displays as 1.20.3). Implement std::str::FromStr with type Err = ParseVersionError, a new public type at the crate root that implements Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, std::fmt::Display and std::error::Error. Parsing accepts exactly three components separated by '.', each a non-empty run of ASCII digits that fits in u64 and has no leading zero unless it is exactly 0. Everything else is an error, including surrounding whitespace, a sign, a 'v' prefix, empty components and suffixes such as -alpha. Parsing a displayed version must give back the same value. Implement PartialOrd and Ord comparing major, then minor, then patch numerically. Add unit tests.
